title: Peminjaman Mobil
shortDescription: Full-featured car rental management system with transaction and fleet tracking.
fullDescription: CarRent Pro is a comprehensive car rental management platform designed for streamlined vehicle booking and fleet administration. It features real-time fleet tracking, booking and transaction management, customer record handling, and an administrative dashboard to monitor availability and rental statuses.

title: Bubur Ayam
shortDescription: Traditional chicken porridge (bubur ayam) online ordering and catalog landing page.
fullDescription: A modern and responsive landing page for a special chicken porridge culinary business. Features menu highlights, location details, and direct WhatsApp ordering integration built with a clean aesthetic interface.

title: TechMart
shortDescription: An interactive e-commerce web application featuring a dynamic product catalog and shopping cart.
fullDescription: TechMart is a modern e-commerce platform developed as an interactive web project. Built using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS, the application delivers a responsive online shopping experience complete with shopping cart management, product category filtering, reactive automatic price calculations, and countdown timers for flash sales and pre-orders.
